description: What one company's published subprocessor list says, as this record holds it: every row quoted as the company wrote it, with the purpose and location it printed, when the row was first and last seen here, the source page and the date it was read. Says so when no list for that company has been read. Free to read, cite and link. Every row is a dated quote of a company's own published page: cite the page and the read date. The compilation is protected: extraction or re-use of a substantial part is not permitted, and it may never be compiled into a lead list, a prospecting feed or a sales tool. A key is one reader's own use.

company.description: A company with a list on this record: its domain (notion.so) or its name (Notion). One company per call.
